rule: An unknown in the public surface passes only on a place of this list, with the same path and form. A place that is not in this list needs the owner's sign-off. Each place is a generic constraint or a match position; none is a value that a user receives. An entry whose declaration is not built yet keeps the name and the short form of the type-level model ("..." marks elided text); the package that builds it writes the built name and the built text of the same form, with the same role.

places.role: Constraint: every state entry (the state of TaskRuntime.forTest)

places.form: N extends NodeRef<unknown, infer E, string> ? E : never
N extends NodeRef<unknown, string, infer NodeId> ? ... : never
